stage: snapshot handle/path metadata comparison for the retained synthetic blind-test executable
rootCause: Windows path stat synthesizes execute permission bits from the .exe suffix; fstat does not. These are not file type, identity, redirect or content differences. Comparing all permission bits rejected a valid retained executable before reading its contents.
remediation: Compare file type (S_IFMT) while retaining device, inode, size, mtime, link count and reparse attributes; retain the held no-write/delete guards. A synthetic .exe-text fixture first reproduces the mismatch without launching anything. No real policy/vault, protected witness, package or source bytes were changed.
developmentLintHistory: Before this committed run, focused tests passed while Ruff reported import/line-length/context formatting and then a loop-closure binding issue. Those authoring defects were corrected and Ruff passed; no test outcome was changed.
